item.description: The _convert_to_int method in the Layout class doesn't properly handle reset values for nested structures, particularly when dealing with dictionaries containing nested objects. Tests fail when trying to construct Signals with complex layouts (StructLayout, UnionLayout) that have reset values represented as dictionaries.
item.contract: When a Layout's _convert_to_int method encounters a dictionary value that represents a nested structure, it should recursively call the nested layout's _convert_to_int method to properly convert the nested values. This will enable proper reset value handling for complex nested layouts.

item.description: The __getattr__ method in the View class doesn't provide proper error messages for missing attributes. When accessing non-existent attributes on Views, it raises generic AttributeError messages instead of helpful error messages that identify missing fields vs. reserved names.
item.contract: The __getattr__ method should provide clearer error messages when accessing non-existent attributes. For reserved names (starting with underscore) that exist in the layout, it should raise a specific error indicating that such attributes can only be accessed via indexing. For regular missing fields, it should provide suggestions of similar field names or list all available fields.

item.description: The const methods in StructLayout, UnionLayout, and ArrayLayout need refinement to properly validate and process constant values according to their respective layout types. Multiple test failures indicate issues with constant initializer validation.
item.contract: The const methods should properly validate that constant initializers are mappings or sequences appropriate for their layout type. For StructLayout and UnionLayout, it should ensure the provided value matches the expected structure. For ArrayLayout, it should handle sequences appropriately.

item.description: The Signal class doesn't properly validate reset values for complex types. The reset value conversion in Signal.__init__ is not robust enough to handle complex reset values that may be dictionaries or other non-primitive types.
item.contract: The Signal class should properly validate and convert reset values to ensure they are constant-castable expressions. When a reset value is not constant-castable, it should raise a TypeError with a clear message.

item.description: The __getitem__ method in View class has incorrect error handling for array indexing. It doesn't provide proper error messages when attempting to index non-array layouts with values.
item.contract: The __getitem__ method should raise a TypeError with a clear message when attempting to index a non-array layout with a value (as opposed to a simple integer key).
